paper.title_en: Creation of the Universe in Lorentzian Classical Gravity
paper.abstract_en: The singularity theorems and the past incompleteness of inflationary spacetimes suggest that the beginning of the Universe lies beyond the domain of semiclassical gravity. We show that the creation of the Universe can nevertheless be understood within Lorentzian gravity by allowing gravitational junctions, so that the full spacetime need not be a smooth manifold. We construct rotationally invariant cosmic creation gates joining any finite number $n\geq2$ of locally de Sitter regions in $D\geq3$ spacetime dimensions at a timelike perfect-fluid junction with $P=wρ$. For $w>-(D-3)/(D-2)$, they are geodesically complete in both temporal directions. The total spatial volume approaches finite, positive limits in the infinite past and future on the global-time foliation adapted to the junction fluid. We also construct exact deformed cosmic creation gates through nonlinear homogeneous backreaction that retain the initial volume while the future volume grows without bound. In these solutions, the junction fluid always expands, cooling for $w>0$ and heating for allowed $w<0$. Keeping the bulk regions locally de Sitter, we determine the linearized perturbations: in three dimensions, the generic inhomogeneous sector contains one hybrid sound mode and $n-1$ relative transverse modes; in four and higher dimensions, only the homogeneous hybrid sound mode survives. A finite-volume beginning requires fine-tuned homogeneous and inhomogeneous initial data, while causal response generically leads to unbounded future spatial volume. We also discuss a broader creation criterion allowing bounded past-volume oscillations. The gravitational equations determine conditioned admissible histories. We discuss implications for cosmology.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在洛伦兹号差引力框架内，通过允许时空具有引力连接面（非光滑流形），探讨宇宙创生与时空奇点/过去不完备性问题，涉及de Sitter区域、完美流体连接面、线性扰动与初始数据微调，属于广义相对论基础与半经典引力边界问题，理论深度较高且构造具体，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 洛伦兹经典引力中的宇宙创生
decision.abstract_zh: 奇点定理与暴胀时空的过去不完备性表明，宇宙的开端位于半经典引力的适用范围之外。我们表明，通过允许引力连接面（gravitational junctions），使得整个时空不必是光滑流形，宇宙的创生仍然可以在洛伦兹引力框架内被理解。我们构造了旋转不变的宇宙创生门（cosmic creation gates），在 $D\geq3$ 维时空中，于 $P=w\rho$ 的类时完美流体连接面处，将任意有限数目 $n\geq2$ 个局部 de Sitter 区域连接起来。对于 $w>-(D-3)/(D-2)$，它们在两个时间方向上都是测地完备的。在适配于连接面流体的全局时间叶层上，总空间体积在无限过去和无限未来都趋于有限的正极限。我们还通过非线性均匀反作用构造了精确的变形宇宙创生门，这些解保持初始体积不变，而未来体积无界增长。在这些解中，连接面流体总是膨胀，对于 $w>0$ 冷却，对于允许的 $w<0$ 加热。在保持体区域局部为 de Sitter 的情况下，我们确定了线性化扰动：在三维中，一般的非均匀扇区包含一个混合声模和 $n-1$ 个相对横模；在四维及更高维中，只有均匀混合声模存活。有限体积的开端需要微调的均匀与非均匀初始数据，而因果响应一般导致未来空间体积无界。我们还讨论了一个更广泛的创生判据，允许有界的过去体积振荡。引力方程决定了受条件约束的容许历史。我们讨论了对宇宙学的启示。
